description: Structured decode of any mainnet transaction by hash. Supply chain ('base' | 'ethereum' | 'solana') and tx_hash. Returns from/to/value/gas/status/calldata for EVM, or slot/fee/signers/program_calls for Solana. Mined txs cached in-process. Use for tx inspection, audit, agent UX (rendering tx summaries to users). $0.001 USDC.
name: decode_tx
